title: Render cached profile avatar in chat messages
goal: Use the locally saved profile avatar for user messages in chat and avoid repeated image decoding during chat updates.
context: Profile avatar bytes are stored in AppStorage under profile.avatar.data and the profile screen already caches a decoded UIImage. Chat bubbles still render a generic person icon, so profile edits are not reflected in chat.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Agent Runtime, policy, permissions, provider routing, workspace execution, conversation persistence, or streaming generation.
Do not decode avatar data inside each ChatBubble body or for each streamed update.
Do not add dependencies or background timers.
Do not claim physical-device smoothness from CI alone.
acceptance_criteria: User message avatars read the same profile.avatar.data value used by Profile.
A changed or cleared profile avatar updates chat without relaunching the app.
Avatar image decoding is cached at the chat panel level and does not repeat for every message or streaming update.
A missing or invalid avatar falls back to the existing person icon.
Agent Task Contract, M3 / Swift package tests, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If image decoding affects scrolling or streaming, revert avatar rendering while keeping the generic fallback and preserve all chat behavior.
